title: NodeKit design rule derived from reference observations
description: A rule a build may be scored against, and the citations it stands on. derivedFrom.factIds is the rule's whole evidentiary base: scripts/reference-corpus-gate.mjs resolves every entry, and a ScoreReceipt that reaches outside this list is reaching past the rule's evidence. doesNotApplyWhen is required because a rule with no stated limits is a house style wearing a citation.

mechanismHypothesis.description: Why the rule is believed to work. Named a hypothesis, not a finding, unless the evidence tier is M3.

doesNotApplyWhen.description: The conditions under which citing this rule is a misuse. Required and non-empty.

boundToGate.description: Where the rule terminates in something a machine can check. A rule that stops at a mechanism hypothesis is a paragraph nobody can run; kind names the artifact that makes it executable. kind:none is allowed, but it must say why, and the corpus gate fails a contract whose rules are mostly none.

kind.description: schema-field: a field the producer must populate. renderer-assertion: a check the renderer enforces at draw time. test: a test that fails when the rule is violated. none: the rule is advisory and nothing checks it.

ref.description: The artifact the rule terminates in, precise enough to open: app/models.py:ResponseMeta.buckets_are_exclusive, src/render.mjs:assertNoPieWhenOverlapping, test/phase-buckets.test.mjs. Required unless kind is none.

reason.description: Why this rule terminates in nothing checkable. Required when kind is none.

problemTags.description: Retrieval tags naming the problem the rule solves. Appearance adjectives are refused by the corpus gate: a corpus you cannot query by problem is a scrapbook.

reVerifyAfterDays.description: Sources stay remote and uncached by licence, so a record can drift from the live product with no local signal. This is the only expiry the corpus has.

evidenceTier.description: M3 audience-task evidence > M2 live shipped-product observation > M1 official demonstration or documentation > M0 recipe or showcase.

qualifiedFactId.description: observationId/factId. The corpus gate resolves every one of these against the recorded facts; a citation that resolves to nothing looks like evidence and binds to none.
